why: Each figure has three parts: one side of the box turned into an arrow (top pointing left, right side pointing up, or left side pointing down), an arrow inside (up, left or down), and 1, 2 or 3 legs. In every row each kind of outer arrow, inner arrow and leg count appears exactly once. Row 3 still needs the right-side up arrow, an inner up arrow and 1 leg, which is option 6. Option 4 has the right arrows but 3 legs, so it is wrong.
trick: When a figure has several parts, check each part separately: every row must use each version once.
